sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: Uses the canonical ratio scale in the current runtime while preserving a separate semantic type.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: Postfix percent in the admitted quantity profile; do not confuse postfix % with integer remainder.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: The Percent value preserves its concrete semantic identity through bindings and arguments. Arithmetic/comparison does not grant I/O authority; console is an explicit effect. Only the documented comparisons and generic constraint profiles apply. A TypeId does not synthesize a user-defined Eq/Ord, clone or drop implementation.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.
